facts.material: pressure-treated pine post and mounting plate (bulk of kit) with galvanized steel helical ground anchor and hardware
facts.function: pedestal base supporting a Little Free Library book box
facts.end_use: garden or front-yard community book exchange

gri_path: GRI 1: ch. 44 note 1 does not exclude; wooden articles fall in 4421; steel anchor would be 7326/7308
GRI 3(b): kit put up for retail sale; wooden post and plate give essential character (bulk, visible, engraved plate); steel anchor is a supporting component
GRI 6: 4421.99 other, other wood articles, not fence posts or pickets

rejected_alternatives.reason: steel fence/studded posts; steel anchor is not the essential character
sawn pickets, posts and rails for fencing; this is a decorative pedestal post
hardware for buildings; not a mounting fitting

classification.rationale: Kit of pine plate and post plus a steel ground anchor; wood gives essential character under GRI 3(b), so heading 4421 other articles of wood, other (4421.99.98.80). L84302 (steel ground spike hardware) was seen but is a different, all-steel product, so only contextual.
